instruction: A hanging lantern shaped as a bell-domed jellyfish, its translucent cap radiating soft aqua light from luminous veins that branch across the surface. Beneath it trail a dozen tapering emissive tentacles in graduated cyan-to-violet, brightest at the base of the bell. A slim dark hanging loop crowns the dome as the only unlit part.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Glowing Jellyfish Lantern in a glowing-emissive style. A hanging lantern shaped as a bell-domed jellyfish, its translucent cap radiating soft aqua light from luminous veins that branch across the surface. Beneath it trail a dozen tapering emissive tentacles in graduated cyan-to-violet, brightest at the base of the bell. A slim dark hanging loop crowns the dome as the only unlit part. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
